All §5Nightmare Bosses §7share the following characteristics:

§51)§7 Upon death, they each grant ×10–20 loot, 13–26 Star Fragments, 4–8 Boxes of Accessories/Seeds/Eggs with a 50% chance, and a Refresher with a 10% chance to every player in the area.

§52)§7 They have ×10 damage, maximum HP, Shields, and Ultra Shields of the boss used for enhancement.
§53)§7 They have a cap on how much damage per second can be dealt to them.
§54)§7 Has 4 times more Soul Integrity.
§55)§7 When below 50% HP, Nightmare bosses enter a berserk state: their speed doubles, and their attacks deal an additional 10% Paragon Damage.
§56)§7 They are cleansed of negative effects every 15 seconds.
§57)§7 If they cannot reach their target within 13 seconds, they enter a Phantasmal Form, allowing them to fly through blocks until they reach the target.
§58)§7 They are immune to any HP modifications while OverShields are active.
§59)§7 They vanish 20 minutes after being summoned.
§510)§7Clears Heal Debt on kill.
§511)§7Each Nightmare boss spawns with a random type.
